Chesapeake Bay from Sandy Point to North Beach-
957 PM EST Wed Nov 25 2026

...STORM WARNING IN EFFECT THROUGH THURSDAY AFTERNOON...
...GALE WARNING IN EFFECT FROM THURSDAY EVENING THROUGH FRIDAY
AFTERNOON...

.REST OF TONIGHT...NE winds 25 to 30 kt...increasing to 35 kt late.
Waves 4 ft. A slight chance of rain late this evening, then rain. 
.THU...NE winds 30 to 40 kt with gusts to 55 kt... becoming E 25 to
30 kt with gusts to 45 kt late. Waves 6 ft. Rain.
.THU NIGHT...E winds 20 to 25 kt...becoming S in the late evening
and overnight. Gusts up to 30 kt...increasing to 35 kt late. Waves
4 ft. A chance of rain. Patchy fog. Vsby 1 to 3 NM. 
.FRI...SW winds 25 to 30 kt. Waves 4 ft. 
.FRI NIGHT...W winds 20 to 25 kt. Waves 3 ft. 
.SAT...W winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts to 25 kt. Waves 2 ft. 
.SAT NIGHT...W winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft. 
.SUN...S winds 15 to 20 kt. Waves 1 to 2 ft...building to 3 ft. Rain
likely through the night. 
.MON...W winds 15 to 20 kt...becoming NW. Waves 2 to 3 ft.
